name: amanah/plans
title: Plan picker
description: Interactive colocation plan picker: tabs, a 3D (or 2D) rack diagram, price, quantity stepper and quote button. The five plans are data in the block's code editor (attribute "plans"). Leave the price-match text empty to hide that box.

heading.default: Pick the footprint that fits today.

intro.default: Every plan sits on the same power, cooling, security and network. Move up a size in the same building when you outgrow it. Published starting prices, per month in Canadian dollars.

priceMatch.default: Price match. Bring a comparable colocation quote for 151 Front and we will beat it by 10%.

note.default: Power, bandwidth and cross connects are quoted to your load.

default.name: Per U colocation
default.who: Your servers in a secure shared cabinet, priced by the rack unit. Right for one to a few servers.
list: Locked shared cabinet with blanking panels
Power and bandwidth quoted to your load

default.name: Quarter rack
default.who: Your own lockable section of a cabinet, with room for a small stack and its network gear.
list: Cross connects in 1 to 2 business days
Upgrade to a larger footprint in the same building

default.name: Half rack
default.who: Half a cabinet behind its own locked door. Room for a growing stack, with space to add more.
list: Power and bandwidth quoted to your load
Move up to a full rack without leaving the building

default.name: Full rack
default.who: A dedicated, locked cabinet for a full stack. Available in TOR1 and TOR2.
list: Up to 25 kW per rack in TOR2
Cross connects with no cap per customer

default.name: Private cage and suite
default.who: Several racks inside your own caged space, with access limited to your team.
list: Dedicated cage with its own access control
Built around your power and cooling plan
Room to add racks as you grow
